wants.topic: Animated cinematic retellings of specific divine battles
wants.evidence: Daksh Cinematics' 'Mahakali vs Raktabeej' and 'Maa Durga vs Shumbh Nishumbh' have extremely high vsNormal scores (1300-1700x).

wants.topic: Lila-based storytelling featuring relatable human-divine interactions
wants.evidence: JagaLeela Studio's 'Adhaiya' series consistently performs 11-13x above normal, suggesting a preference for character-driven narratives over pure historical recitation.

wants.topic: Origin stories of specific deities (Untold/Full Life stories)
wants.evidence: KATHA SAGAR's 'Ganesh Ji' origin story achieved massive reach (33M+ views), indicating high demand for comprehensive, long-form mythological biographies.

wants.topic: Moral-based lessons (Moral Story) integrated into mythological figures
wants.evidence: Rasiya Films' success with 'Moral Story' branding on Vaishno Devi and Ramayana content shows the audience favors educational/inspirational angles.

gaps: High-quality 3D animation for lesser-known regional saints or specific 'Bhakta' stories beyond the main Pantheon
Interactive storytelling where viewers can influence the outcome or request specific divine interventions
Deep-dive explanations of why certain deities took specific forms (the 'reasoning' behind the myth is often left unanswered in short clips)
saturated: Generic 'Dashavatars' summaries which are now treated as background noise
Short-form clips of 'Hanuman vs Bheem' or generic ego-clash videos which have low engagement compared to full-length narratives
Repetitive 'Kaliya Mardan' or 'Mahishasur Vadh' content without a unique visual or narrative twist
title_patterns: Using 'vs' or 'Battle' in titles for conflict-based mythological stories
Including 'Animated Film' or '3D Animation' to signal production quality
Using emotional hooks like 'जब स्वयं भगवान बने' (When God himself became) or 'अद्भुत कथा' (Amazing story)
Capitalizing on 'Full Movie' or 'Sampurna Katha' to denote long-form, high-value content
